name: Can I sue if I was partially at fault for my fall?
description: Yes, in California, you can still sue even if partially at fault, but your compensation will be reduced by your percentage of responsibility.

mainEntity.name: Can I sue if I was partially at fault for my fall?

acceptedAnswer.text: California operates under a legal principle called 'pure comparative negligence.' This means that even if you were partially at fault for your trip and fall, you can still pursue a claim for damages. However, the amount of compensation you receive will be reduced by your percentage of fault. For example, if you are found to be 20% at fault, your total compensation would be reduced by 20%. An attorney can help determine your potential liability and protect your rights throughout the process.
